name: ims.session-memory
description: IMS session state tools for managing (project_id, user_id, agent_id, task_id) sessions.

tools.name: auto_session
tools.description: Primary entry point. Given a project and user message, either resume an open session or create a new one.

agent_id.description: Agent role identifier (planner, implementer, debugger, etc.).

tools.name: continue_session
tools.description: Resolve or create a concrete session for a specific (project_id,user_id,agent_id,task_id) tuple.

initial_state.description: Optional initial SessionState payload to seed a new session.

tools.name: wrap_session
tools.description: Persist an updated SessionState snapshot for a given session tuple (pause/hand-off/finish).

state.description: Complete SessionState to persist (including session_id and identity fields).

tools.name: list_open_sessions
tools.description: List open sessions for a given (project_id,user_id) pair.

tools.name: resume_session
tools.description: Explicitly resume a session by session_id.
